content: {"like":["Historical dramas with rich detail and action, like The Last Kingdom.","Period pieces that bring history alive, such as The Devil's Mistress.","Well-written comedies featuring strong chemistry, e.g., Legally Blonde.","Series with strong final seasons, exemplified by The Twilight Zone Season 5.","Documentaries covering a figure comprehensively, like Teddy Roosevelt – An American Lion."],"dislike":["Shows that mishandle dinosaurs, as in Primeval New World.","Poorly animated dinosaur content, such as Dinosaurs of the Jurassic Collection.","Dated 1930s elements in older films, like the Hitchcock original of 39 Steps.","Any depiction of dinosaurs that feels out of place or poorly executed.","Animations with low production quality that detract from the viewing experience."]}
